_doc: Quests from the sim's state (core/deals/deals_quests.gd). Offers are made once per settlement per game day from the sim as it stands when someone first asks, choices by a hash of (world seed, site, day), and kept for the day. Per kind: givers (roles, first present wins; keeper stands in when the town has none of them), days (time limit), coin (base + per, bounded by wealth_share of the town's wealth), standing, xp, item (chance of a smith-made piece), why (lines with placeholders), goal (one line). Placeholders: {town}, {lair}, {what}, {dest}, {raiders}, {good}, {n}, {site}, {dir}, {dist}, {faction}. abandon: standing lost when the party gives up (escort and defence only). beaten: share of the coin and standing paid when someone else got there first. Distances are tiles from the town.

why: The {what} at {lair} has been hunting the roads out of {town}.
{lair} again. Something has to be done about the {what}.
Our wagons leave for {dest}. The road has teeth lately.
A caravan for {dest} wants another blade beside it.
escort.goal: Walk with the caravan to {dest} and see most of it arrive.

why: {raiders} took our {good}. They're still out there with it.
Raiders from {site} hit our wagons. The {good} was ours.
recover.goal: Bring back {n} {good} taken by raiders from {site}.

why: {town} is hungry. Bread is dear and the granary is thin.
We are eating the seed corn. Bring food, any food.
Raiders from {site} are on their way here. We need every arm.
{raiders} are coming for {town}. Stand with the watch.
defend.goal: Be in {town} when the raiders from {site} arrive, and beat them.

why: Someone ought to look in on {site}. It's been too quiet.
Take word to {site} and tell me what you find.
The {what} of {lair} takes what it likes from us. Our patron asks you to end it.
No one else can face {lair}. We ask you.
{site} is under siege by {raiders}. Break it.
Our people in {site} are starving behind their walls.

done_lines.beaten: Someone got there first. Take this for the walk.
done_lines.failed: It didn't go the way we hoped.
done_lines.lapsed: The world moved on without us.
